content: For experiments on fine-tuning the RNNG with the unsupervised RNNG, we take the discriminative parser (which is also pretrained alongside the RNNG on induced trees) to be the structured inference network for optimizing the evidence lower bound. We refer the reader to BIBREF17 and their open source implementation for additional details. We also observe that as noted by BIBREF17 , a URNNG trained from scratch on this version of PTB without punctuation failed to outperform a right-branching baseline.
